item.title: Brahma Vandana
item.description:
Deva Vandito Tuj, Tu Brahma Brahma Devay
Sang Saraswati, Tu Brahma Brahma Devay

Chaturmukh Dhaari Drishta, Tu Brahma Brahma Devay
Chaturbhuj Dhaari Karta, Tu Brahma Brahma Devay
Granth Dhaari Geet, Tu Brahma Brahma Devay
Maala Dhaari Reet, Tu Brahma Brahma Devay…1

Jal Dhaari Kamandal, Tu Brahma Brahma Devay
Bhumi Dhaari Kamal, Tu Brahma Brahma Devay
Agni Dhaari Ravi, Tu Brahma Brahma Devay
Vayu Dhaari Daadhi, Tu Brahma Brahma Devay…2

Laal Dhaari Lahoo, Tu Brahma Brahma Devay
Kesari Dhaari Dhwaj, Tu Brahma Brahma Devay
Peeli Dhaari Haldi, Tu Brahma Brahma Devay
Hari Dhaari Kheti, Tu Brahma Brahma Devay…3

item.title: Ganapati Vandana
item.description:
Deva Vandito Tuj, Aadi Ganapati, Ushtha Ganapati
Zhale Ekaache Don, Aadi Ganapati, Ushtha Ganapati

Arambh Ganapati, Tuch Aadi Ganapati
Anant Ganapati, Tuch Ushtha Ganapati
Purna Ganapati, Tuch Aadi Ganapati
Apurna Ganapati, Tuch Ushtha Ganapati…1

Ekta Ganapati, Tuch Aadi Ganapati
Gauri Ganapati, Tuch Ushtha Ganapati
Ekarup Ganapati, Tuch Aadi Ganapati
Bahurop Ganapati, Tuch Ushtha Ganapati…2

Sthir Ganapati, Tuch Aadi Ganapati
Asthir Ganapati, Tuch Ushtha Ganapati
Shant Ganapati, Tuch Aadi Ganapati
Ashant Ganapati, Tuch Ushtha Ganapati…3

item.title: Gauri Vandana
item.description:
Gauri Vandito Tuj, Hathdurge Navadurge
Gauri Ganapati, Riddhi Siddhi Tu Mahadurge

He Riddhi Tu Hathdurge, He Siddhi Tu Navadurge
He Shakti Tu Hathdurge, He Bhakti Tu Navadurge…1

Dukh Haari Tu Hathdurge, Sukh Dhaari Tu Navadurge
Hath Haari Tu Hathdurge, Nat Dhaari Tu Navadurge…2

Dasvidye Tu Hathdurge, Navarupe Tu Navadurge
Atarangi Tu Hathdurge, Navarangi Tu Navadurge…3

Mahakali Tu Hathdurge, Shailyaputri Tu Navadurge
Maa Tara Tu Hathdurge, Brahmacharini Tu Navadurge…4

Gauri Vandito Tuj, Hathdurge Navadurge
Gauri Ganapati, Riddhi Siddhi Tu Mahadurge

item.title: Maitreya Buddha Vandana
item.description:
Deva Vandito Tuj
Tu Maitreya Buddhaya Maha Buddhaya

Sang Kalki An Ganesha,
Tu Maitreya Buddhaya Maha Buddhaya

Vinamra Siddha Anima,
Tu Maitreya Buddhaya Maha Buddhaya
Kaam Bhogi Kaamarupi,
Tu Maitreya Buddhaya Maha Buddhaya…1

Karuna Siddha Mahima,
Tu Maitreya Buddhaya Maha Buddhaya
Pavitra Yogi Suryarupi,
Tu Maitreya Buddhaya Maha Buddhaya…2

Maryada Siddha Garima,
Tu Maitreya Buddhaya Maha Buddhaya
Prem Rogi Chandrarupi,
Tu Maitreya Buddhaya Maha Buddhaya…3

Tatpara Siddha Laghima,
Tu Maitreya Buddhaya Maha Buddhaya
Sukh Dhyani Agnirupi,
Tu Maitreya Buddhaya Maha Buddhaya…4

item.title: Shiva Vandana
item.description:
Deva Vandito Tuj, Tu Shivay Shivay
Sang Kaali An Durga, Tu Shivay Shivay

Chandra Dhaari Kaal, Tu Shivay Shivay
Damaru Dhaari Kampan, Tu Shivay Shivay
Kaali Dhaari Kaalinath, Tu Shivay Shivay
Durga Dhaari Durganath, Tu Shivay Shivay…1

Bhasma Dhaari Shav, Tu Shivay Shivay
Bhaang Dhaari Bhram, Tu Shivay Shivay
Aadi Dhaari Adinath, Tu Shivay Shivay
Amar Dhaari Amarnath, Tu Shivay Shivay…2

Deva Vandito Tuj, Tu Shivay Shivay
Sang Kaali An Durga, Tu Shivay Shivay

item.title: Vishnu Vandana
item.description:
Deva Vandito Tuj, Tu Vishnu Tu Narayana
Sang Lakshmi, Tu Vishnu Tu Narayana

Chakra Dhaari Chakradhar, Tu Vishnu Tu Narayana
Shankha Dhaari Shankhadhar, Tu Vishnu Tu Narayana
Urja Dhaari Urjanath, Tu Vishnu Tu Narayana
Path Dhaari Pathnath, Tu Vishnu Tu Narayana.1

Vaikuntha Dhaari Vaikunthadhar, Tu Vishnu Tu Narayana
Hiranya Dhaari Hiranyadhar, Tu Vishnu Tu Narayana
Grah Dhaari Grahanath, Tu Vishnu Tu Narayana
Pataal Dhaari Pataalnath, Tu Vishnu Tu Narayana.2

Bhagya Dhaari Bhagyanath, Tu Vishnu Tu Narayana
Punya Dhaari Punyanath, Tu Vishnu Tu Narayana
Vasu Dhaari Vasudev, Tu Vishnu Tu Narayana
Avataar Dhaari Avataari, Tu Vishnu Tu Narayana.3
